kind: Bounded local ordinary-input two-client lifecycle; not classroom or hosted acceptance

checks.evidence: Two ordinary Chrome tabs created/joined the same anonymous room, both Ready, host Start.
Ordinary keyboard/mouse input drove and aimed both tanks. No game-state or WebSocket injection.
First-round p2 health 3 to 2 to 1 to 0; early refire left shot/health unchanged during reload.
p2 death with 4.5667 seconds remaining, then health 3 at respawn.
Rejoin seat visibly disconnected/recovered, returned p1 to the same active match and position.
Ordinary route captured all seven bases, including red-owned East Orchard; both clients reported blue winner and displayed Blue 7 / Red 0.
Host Rematch reset winner, all bases and readiness. Both clients displayed Waiting for battle and Hulls spawn at battle start, not destroyed/zero-hull combat HUD.
Both marked Ready again, host started, both spawned with health 3 and drove to the bridge. Guest shot id 5 hit p1; both clients observed p1 health 2.
Five captured log entries per client, all log level; no captured warning/error. Startup scene/effect draw verification succeeded on both.
Closed only the two test tabs. Owned Node process exited; bounded GET to its IPv4-loopback endpoint was actively refused.

limitations: Read-only WebSocket observation had buffer eviction across some gaps; this is not a continuous packet recording.
Screenshots are selected state captures, not continuous video.
One operator controlled two real browser clients on one desktop. No independent human, school-device, 4v4, latency or sustained-frame-time acceptance.
Same-page Rejoin was tested; refresh recovery and actual provider restart were not.
Portrait barrel framing, camera collision and busy-effect performance remain untested in this run.
No hosted service, deployment or access change.
